series.name: PK split high-wall inverter (official TSP + LED blink map)
series.notes: Official Midea TSP Split High Wall Inverter fault table (LED blink map fields). PK lines: Xtreme/XtremePlus/Breezeless E/Titan/Eco/Go Easy.

meaning.en: Indoor PCB main chip does not receive feedback from EEPROM chip.
meaning.ur: Indoor PCB par memory chip ka data kharab hona

causes.en: Memory chip data on the control board is corrupted or the chip is not seated.
causes.ur: Control board par memory chip ka data kharab hona ya chip sahi tareeqe se baithi na ho

causes.en: Board-level fault after power surges or interrupted supply.
causes.ur: Voltage ke achanak urne ya supply cutne ke baad board level ki kharabi.

solutions.en: Power off at the isolator for about 10 minutes, then restart to attempt a reset.
solutions.ur: Isolator se 10 minute ke liye band karke dobara on karke reset karwayein.

solutions.en: If the code returns, reseat or replace the EEPROM/indoor PCB as per the service manual.
solutions.ur: Agar code wapas aaye to EEPROM/indoor PCB ko dobara lagayein ya tabdeel karein

notes.en: Scope: Split High Wall Inverter, 2nd GEN LED blink map (Running/Timer lamps); matches Midea service-manual E/F/P family (E4 & P3 reserved).
notes.ur: Yeh entries Split High Wall Inverter, 2nd GEN ke LED blink map ke hain (Running/Timer lamps); Midea service-manual ke E/F/P family se milte hain (E4 aur P3 reserved hain).

meaning.en: Indoor/outdoor unit communication error
meaning.ur: Indoor aur outdoor unit ke darmiyan rabta tootna

causes.en: Loose, broken or wrongly landed wiring between indoor and outdoor units.
causes.ur: Indoor aur outdoor ke darmiyan wiring dheeli, tooti ya ghalat lagi hui ho

causes.en: Faulty indoor/outdoor control board or S-line driver.
causes.ur: Indoor/outdoor control board ya S-line driver kharab hona

solutions.en: Switch off power, wait one minute, check L/N/S/GND wiring and re-terminate securely.
solutions.ur: Power off karke aik minute ruken, L/N/S/GND wiring check karke mazboot se dobara lagayein

solutions.en: Power-cycle and verify outdoor PCB status LEDs; replace the faulty board if the link still fails.
solutions.ur: Power cycle karein aur outdoor PCB ke status LED check karein; agar rabta phir bhi na bane to kharab board tabdeel karein

notes.en: Scope: Split High Wall Inverter, 2nd GEN LED blink map (Running/Timer lamps); matches Midea service-manual E/F/P family (E4 & P3 reserved).
notes.ur: Yeh entries Split High Wall Inverter, 2nd GEN ke LED blink map ke hain (Running/Timer lamps); Midea service-manual ke E/F/P family se milte hain (E4 aur P3 reserved hain).

meaning.en: Zero-crossing signal detection error
meaning.ur: PCB par timing signal ki durusti kharab hona

causes.en: Fault detected by the unit self-diagnosis; exact cause depends on model and series.
causes.ur: Unit ke khud karne wale diagnosis ne kharabi pakri; asal wajah model aur series par mubtala hai

causes.en: Wiring, sensor, board or refrigerant circuit issue matching this code.
causes.ur: Is code se milti jalti wiring, sensor, board ya refrigerant circuit ki masla

solutions.en: Power-cycle once; if it clears, monitor for recurrence.
solutions.ur: Aik baar power cycle karein; agar saaf ho jaye to dobara hone par nazar rakhein

solutions.en: If it persists, stop the unit and call an authorised Midea service technician.
solutions.ur: Agar barqarar rahe to unit band karke Midea ke authorized service technician ko bulaayen

notes.en: Scope: Split High Wall Inverter, 2nd GEN LED blink map (Running/Timer lamps); matches Midea service-manual E/F/P family (E4 & P3 reserved).

title.en: Indoor fan speed out of control
title.ur: Indoor fan speed control se bahar

meaning.en: The indoor fan speed is operating outside of the normal range
meaning.ur: Indoor fan ki shaft speed normal range par nahi chal rahi

causes.en: Indoor/outdoor fan motor stuck, obstructed, or Hall feedback missing.
causes.ur: Fan motor atka hua ya ruka hua, ya Hall feedback nahi aa raha

causes.en: Fan connector or PCB drive circuit fault.
causes.ur: Fan connector ya PCB drive circuit kharab hona

solutions.en: Power off, spin the fan by hand for binding, clear debris, and check connectors.
solutions.ur: Power off karke fan ko haath se ghumayein, debris saaf karein aur connectors check karein

solutions.en: Replace the fan motor if windings/feedback fail; otherwise replace the control board.
solutions.ur: Agar motor ki windings/feedback kharab ho to fan motor tabdeel karein, warna control board tabdeel karein

notes.en: Scope: Split High Wall Inverter, 2nd GEN LED blink map (Running/Timer lamps); matches Midea service-manual E/F/P family (E4 & P3 reserved).
notes.ur: Yeh entries Split High Wall Inverter, 2nd GEN ke LED blink map ke hain (Running/Timer lamps); Midea service-manual ke E/F/P family se milte hain (E4 aur P3 reserved hain).

title.ur: Indoor room temperature sensor T1 ka open/short fault

meaning.en: Indoor room temperature sensor T1 is in open circuit or has short circuited
meaning.ur: Room temperature sensor ka open/short circuit hona

causes.en: Sensor connector loose, wire chafed, or sensor element open/shorted.
causes.ur: Sensor connector dheela, wire kati hui, ya sensor element open/short hona

causes.en: Moisture or rodent damage at the sensor harness.
causes.ur: Sensor harness mein nami ya chuha ki kharabi.

solutions.en: Check plug seating and measure sensor resistance against the manual table; reseat or replace.
solutions.ur: Plug check karein, manual ke mutabiq sensor ki resistance naappein, dobara lagayein ya tabdeel karein

solutions.en: If resistance is open/shorted with a good connector, replace the thermistor.
solutions.ur: Agar connector theek ho phir bhi resistance open/short ho to thermistor tabdeel karein

notes.en: Scope: Split High Wall Inverter, 2nd GEN LED blink map (Running/Timer lamps); matches Midea service-manual E/F/P family (E4 & P3 reserved).
notes.ur: Yeh entries Split High Wall Inverter, 2nd GEN ke LED blink map ke hain (Running/Timer lamps); Midea service-manual ke E/F/P family se milte hain (E4 aur P3 reserved hain).

meaning.en: System lacks refrigerant
meaning.ur: System mein refrigerant ki kami ya leak ki wajah se chal raha hona

causes.en: Leak in the refrigerant circuit or undercharge from long service.
causes.ur: Refrigerant circuit mein leak ya lambi istemal ki wajah se charge kam hona

causes.en: Leak sensor out of range or false trigger from dirty coil.
causes.ur: Leak sensor out of range ya gande coil se ghalat trigger

solutions.en: Do not run long; call a technician to leak-test, repair, evacuate and recharge.
solutions.ur: Zyada na chalayein; technician se leak check, marammat, evacuation aur recharge karwaayein

solutions.en: Clean coils first if the sensor reading may be false, then re-check.
solutions.ur: agar sensor ghalat ho sakta hai to pehle coil saaf kr ke dobaara check karein
